bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 收复 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Microsoft rose 1.5% on Oct 26 to $532.60, trading between $521.69 and $533.25. It is above the falling 5-day ($528.6) and 10-day ($532.2) averages and the rising 30-day ($518.7), 100-day ($461.0) and 200-day ($436.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 but is above zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($545.99), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: 微软 10月26日上涨 1.5%，收于 $532.60，盘中区间 $521.69–533.25。股价位于下行的 5 日（$528.6）和 10 日均线（$532.2）以及上行的 30 日（$518.7）、100 日（$461.0）和 200 日均线（$436.8）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$545.99），RSI 为 57。

read.en: The close cleared the $525 resistance and the 5 and 10-day averages. Resistance is $533.3–535.6 (Oct 26 and Oct 19 highs), then $544–546 (Oct 16 high, SAR) and $551–554 (Oct 13 high, 52-week high). Support is $525–528.6 (Oct 20–21 lows, 5-day), then $515.7–518.7 (Oct 23 low, 30-day) and $497–502. A close above $535.6 would target $544–546; a close below $515.7 would open $497–502.
